sources.snippet: Any prompting tricks and image-prompt combos from 1.0 and 1.2 will transfer poorly to 1.4. 1.4 Is more closely aligned with the original 0.3 beta model than previous versions. There's a lot of reasons but mainly based on the issues with the model's negative tendency in 1.0 and 1.2 was only solvable by fully reshaping and remaking it.
